text:
Jordan: Quick experiment notes — ran a mini sweep tying the token_budget target to stream flush latency this morning. Observed kernel-switch thrash around ~20–30ms during partial-decoding flushes.
Priya: Can you paste the config you ran? curious about queue weights and token_budget thresholds.
Jordan: Sure — here's the exact run stanza we used:
```
batcher: {
  max_batch_tokens: 4096,
  token_budget_target_ms: 40,
  stream_flush_aggression: 0.35,
  queue_weights: { small: 1.0, normal: 0.9, priority: 1.2 }
}
kernel_hints: { small_kernel_cutoff: 128, large_kernel_cutoff: 512 }
```
infra-bot: Perf alert: canary-rc-12 spike detected at 3623456792 — 95th latency +18% vs baseline :warning:
Sam: Important — how did KV cache behave? partial flushes often break KV warmups and force kernel reroutes.
Jordan: KV hit-rate before sweep ~72% for our chat workload. With stream_flush_aggression at 0.35 it dropped to ~58% (more early sends so more cold KV windows).
Marta: Maybe we should bias the admission queue to preserve KV affinity when token_budget < 512. i.e., weight queue by kv_age_penalty. Small batches are cheap but kill cache locality.
Ken: I ran a microprofile with `--trace-kv` on the same canary. Snippet:
```
TRACE: batch_id=9823 kv_miss=14 kv_hit=38 preemptive_flush=6 kernel_switches=9
P95_decode_ms=47 P50=12
```
Alex: Noted — also saw many partial-decode tasks preemptively scheduled because the batch target wasn't met and stream timeout fired. Need a tie-breaker: prefer completing partial-decodes in-progress over starting a flush if batch_size < 4.
Jordan: Agreed. Plan: 1) lower stream_flush_aggression to 0.2 for next sweep, 2) add kv_age_penalty to queue_weights (start with 0.25), 3) change partial-decode scheduler tie-breaker to prefer in-flight decodes when inflight_tokens < 256.
Priya: Can we also add a kernel-hint smoothing window to avoid oscillation? e.g., require 3 consecutive batch samples before switching kernel.
Jordan: Yes — implement hysteresis: kernel_switch_min_consec=3. Also will add a small backoff when KV hit-rate drops >10% relative to baseline.
Marta: SGTM. If the canary with these changes shows p95 improvement without KV hit-rate <60% we can roll to stable.
Ken: I'll attach the trace and a flame view to the PR.
Alex: one more: add a debug metric `partial_flush_cause` with values {timeout, token_budget, kernel_switch} so we can quantify root causes.
Jordan: Good call. I'll open the canary PR now and pin the experiment ID. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
